sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cottonwood-lake-campground ('Cottonwood Lake Campground has 25 sites and is situated on a gently sloping hillside surrounded by aspen trees'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Two accessible toilets (type not stated); no water - bring your own. Firewood sold at the host site.

values.note: May to September; opening and closing dates are weather dependent.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cottonwood-lake-campground (Seasons of Use 'May to September. Opening and closing dates are weather dependent.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Claim a site in person; pay at the self-service fee tube (cash, check or money order). Popular with anglers and full on weekends; if full, dispersed camping is allowed along CR 344 from 1 mile west.

values.note: $22 a site (two vehicles or one RV included); third vehicle $10.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cottonwood-lake-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Salida RD (Pike-San Isabel NF) campground on an aspen hillside at ~9,600 ft, about 9 miles west of Buena Vista off the Cottonwood Pass Road (CR 306), 3 miles up gravel CR 344; a walk to Cottonwood Lake and the creek for trout fishing. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 25 FCFS sites, no water, $22 (third vehicle $10). Added season (May-September), booking note (self-pay tube, dispersed overflow on CR 344), senior/access discount. Cleared vault_toilets: the page says only '2 accessible toilets'. No length is published anywhere. Pin is wrong (see flags). Lakeview doubtful (see flags). Note trimmed of site count, water and FCFS facts.
flags: Pin ~380 m off: the stored pin (38.7825,-106.2858) sits in the willow marsh at Cottonwood Lake's west inlet. The campground loops are on the hillside right at the FS point, 38.78280,-106.29020 (USGS summer imagery shows the loop there, on the north side of CR 344).

Lakeview doubtful: the loops are on an aspen hillside ~350-450 m west of the lake's open water, with the marsh and willows between. The FS page says only 'within walking distance to the lake'. A view from the sites can't be confirmed under the canopy; by the default-down rule this is 'not waterfront' unless a site photo shows the lake. Waterfront left for the curator.

Rig length: no agency figure (no recreation.gov listing, and the FS page gives no spur lengths). The FS page does not single it out for small rigs. CR 344 is described only as the 3-mile access road; no condition or 4WD advice found, and no current forest order touches it.
Missing phone: Salida Ranger District, 719-539-3591 (FS page).
Website: stored link is the forest home page; the campground's page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cottonwood-lake-campground.
